Syrian Airport Hit by Unidentified Aircraft Strikes

An out-of-service military airport in northwest Syria's Idlib province was struck by four unidentified aircraft. This marks the first attack on the location since the fall of the Assad regime. The specific targets within the airport and the identity of the aircraft remain unconfirmed.
